values./system/description:
A large, leather mitt, used to protect the hands and wrists while punching. While originally used during sporting matches, a skilled fighter can use these to deliver solid blows to enemies in less organized fights, particularly if they’ve modified the glove in some way.

A boxing glove can accept one of the following mods which are installed with the Repair skill:

  • Boxing Glove: Spiked, Puncturing, Lead Lining
